criteria.H1: Economic: block V net of the one-account 1 oz schema router (PQ_30 execution, queue language) > 0 with day-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0. Zero trades = NO_TRADE (not a pass). Evaluated separately for prequential and frozen-at-V learning.
criteria.H2: Null control: shuffled_context promotes 0 schemas and makes 0 trades in block V.
criteria.H3_cost: Execution: for every plan, paired daily mean of PQ_30 attempt minus TT attempt on block V has day-bootstrap lower bound > 0.
criteria.H3_selection: Adverse selection replicates: daily mean taker net where PQ_30 did not fill minus where it filled has lower bound > 0.
criteria.H4: Resting ranking (model fitted on Oct-Feb): for plan (12, 8, 120), R^2 on V vs the train mean > 0 AND daily mean attempt of the top prediction decile minus the bottom half (edges from train predictions) has lower bound > 0.
criteria.H5: Opportunity stage-0 gate: per horizon, the challenger fitted on Oct-Feb beats the train-scaled causal premium (MSE skill > 0) in BOTH March and April.
criteria.H6: Schema knowledge: on V, attempts of short/40-20-600 in trend=down are worse than all short/40-20-600 attempts (daily paired residual, upper bound < 0).
criteria.R0: Reproducibility: prequential, assimilate_only and shuffled_context A/B block metrics equal the earlier train-only queue-language run.
